purpose: Verifiable identity contract for the untracked, externally provisioned Tier 2 build inputs listed in docs/testing/clean-worktree-verification.md section 1. Every file entry pins one exact byte sequence; the commit entry pins the upstream checkout revision. tools/ci/verify_inputs.ps1 checks a local tree against this file and fails closed. This contract verifies inputs; it never downloads, fetches or fabricates them. A cache refresh is an explicit maintainer action with a reviewed provenance change.
